events.title: SCOTT WHATMAN
events.location: The Stage (18+), 2 Wharf st, Tweed Heads, NSW 2486
events.description: Scott has an incredibly large vocal range which enables him to perform a very diverse range of music. He loves performing with both acoustic and electric guitar and makes great use of both at his solo shows. Scott performs classics like Hotel California (The Eagles) Crazy Little Thing Called Love (Queen), songs by Pink Floyd, Fleetwood Mac and Eric Clapton as well as current songs by Bruno Mars, Ed Sheeran, George Ezra, The Chainsmokers, Charlie Puth and Sam Smith

events.title: BRIT BEAT MANIA
events.location: The Showroom, 2 Wharf st, Tweed Heads, NSW 2486
events.description: Brit Beat Mania  Brit Beat Mania - are widely regarded as one of Queensland’s best Pop Tribute Show Bands as  they re-create the look, the sound and the magic that was The British Invasion.  Their professionally presented show has been wowing audiences taking Baby Boomers back to  their teens with an entertaining, fun, and interactive journey with songs from legendary artists  such as Cliff Richard, Herman’s Hermits, The Hollies, Tom Jones, Gerry & the Pacemakers, The  Beatles, The Rolling Stones and the many more who created the British Invasion.  Tony Worsley  Tony Worsley burst into the Australian recording industry in the early 60's and his  success was instantaneous. Hit after hit including "Missing You", "Raining in my Heart",  "Knocking on Wood" as well as the Gold single "Velvet Waters".  In 1965 Tony toured nationally with The Kinks, Manfred Mann and The Honeycombs, playing to  packed houses of screaming fans. Tony has shared the stage with The Dave Clark Five, The  Seekers, Johnny O'Keefe and John Farnham.  Tony’s onstage personality is full of charisma and his presentation is as vibrant and polished now  as that of any world-class entertainer.  So be ready to be entertained and transported back to the era that changed the musical  landscape around the world that was The Sound of the 60’s.

events.description: People of all ages love board games. They’re entertaining, stimulate the mind, enhance the memory and exercise cognitive skills. Most importantly, they’re a whole lot of fun.    You’re invited to join a new group at Twin Towns, The Board Gamers. It’s the perfect excuse to get out of the house, connect socially with other members and make new friends, and enjoy morning tea and a chat. The best part, it’s all free.    Second and fourth Wednesday of the month from 10.45am-12pm Qld, Signatures on the Lobby Level at The Sebel Twin Towns.

events.title: ANH DO
events.location: The Showroom, 2 Wharf st, Tweed Heads, NSW 2486
events.description: Anh Do’s bestselling book The Happiest Refugee has made readers laugh and cry, and was described by Russell Crowe as 'the most surprising and inspiring read I have had in years.'  Anh’s stage show takes it a step further, combining stand-up comedy with real life stories, photos and filmed pieces to retell his amazing story. events.location: Club Banora Lounge, 2 Leisure Dr, Banora Point NSW 2486, Australia

events.location: The Stage (18+), 2 Wharf st, Tweed Heads, NSW 2486
events.description: The Don Rogers Band is an Australian country rock four-piece led by singer-songwriter Don Rogers from Queensland’s Gold Coast. Blending outlaw country with rock ’n’ roll grit, the band delivers big hooks, raw vocals, and high-energy live shows. Their debut single “Light It Up” introduces a bold, guitar-driven sound rooted in real stories and modern country rock attitude.

events.title: THE HARMONY GUYS
events.location: The Stage (18+), 2 Wharf st, Tweed Heads, NSW 2486
events.description: The HARMONY GUYS are a four-piece vocal/instrumental band who perform four-part harmony songs, creating a wonderful blend of vocal sounds for all genres.    Having individually performed in shows with the likes of The Delltones, Ted Mulray Gang and The Cliff Richard Experience, this combination of talented musicians delivers a performance of unforgettable excellence.    With an expansive repertoire of songs from the 60’s, 70’s and 80’s they also perform favourite hits from The Beach Boys, The Hollies, Cliff Richard & The Shadows, The Mavericks, The Eagles, The Beatles, ELO and many more. The ever-popular Gold Coast based HARMONY GUYS are undoubtedly the most enjoyable and unique band in the entertainment scene.
